answer: A practical defence against Sybil agents is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks tokens to its registered address before its votes count, so creating clones costs real capital. Like cedar roots holding soil, the stake anchors one identity to one history, while an opal-like reputation score that only grows through verified work separates genuine agents from fresh copies. A jetty-style gateway checks signatures at entry, rejects duplicate keys, and when abuse is proven the stake is slashed and paid to harmed parties, so cloning stops paying.
